Bordeira (Fogo) summit
trails.why: Bordeira is a semicircular mountain in the middle of the island Fogo. It is a crater rim, up to 1 km high, formed by a prehistoric collapse of the volcano Pico do Fogo.

trails.name: Topo da Coroa summit
trails.why: Tope de Coroa is a mountain on the island of Santo Antão's, Cape Verde. At 1,979 m elevation, it is the highest point of the island.

trails.name: Pico da Antónia
trails.why: Pico de Antónia is a mountain located in the central part of the island of Santiago in Cape Verde.

trails.name: Monte Graciosa
trails.why: Monte Graciosa is a mountain in the northern part of the island of Santiago in Cape Verde.

trails.name: Monte Penoso
trails.why: Monte Penoso is a mountain on the island of Maio, Cape Verde. At 436 m elevation, it is the island highest point.
